euRows.quote: achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity
euRows.rationale: Credential hygiene is one input to cybersecurity; the provision names no credential, storage, or rotation requirement.

euRows.quote: resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use, outputs
euRows.rationale: Over-broad cloud IAM is an access-control weakness, not by itself an AI-specific manipulation path.

euRows.quote: effectively overseen by natural persons during the period in which they are in use
euRows.rationale: Approval-marker proximity is close to the design duty and the ability to refrain; oversight outside the file cannot be seen.

euRows.quote: technically allow for the automatic recording of events (logs) over the lifetime
euRows.rationale: The rule tests the existence of logging near a high-risk action, not retention, integrity, or Art. 12(3) content.

euRows.quote: natural persons concerned are informed that they are interacting with an AI system
euRows.rationale: The rule reads a system prompt; the provision is about what the natural person is told, which is often rendered elsewhere.

euRows.quote: resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use, outputs
euRows.rationale: An unauthenticated route is general application security; the rule does not show the route reaches a model.

euRows.quote: to decide, in any particular situation, not to use the high-risk AI system
euRows.rationale: A status assignment is not proof of sole automation, nor that the system falls under Annex III point 1(a).

euRows.quote: resilient against attempts by unauthorised third parties to alter their use, outputs
euRows.rationale: Wildcard CORS is a web-security weakness; the link to manipulation of AI use or outputs is indirect.

euRows.quote: Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to data governance
euRows.rationale: The rule detects committed documents by filename and extension; those are not necessarily training, validation, or testing data.

euRows.quote: alter their use, outputs or performance by exploiting system vulnerabilities
euRows.rationale: Deserialisation is a concrete exploitation path of the kind the provision addresses; trust in the data is not established.

euRows.quote: achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness, and cybersecurity
euRows.rationale: Error text disclosure is not addressed by the provision; the mapping is adjacency, not correspondence.

euRows.quote: to decide, in any particular situation, not to use the high-risk AI system
euRows.rationale: A bypass flag can remove the ability to refrain; the rule cannot tell whether the flag is reachable in production.
